title: CoverageAttested (extension X4)
description: Extends trace.schema.json with the runtime-computed coverage ledger. Every field here is derived from real tool calls; none of it is reported by the model. Prompting a model to 'be sure you looked everywhere' is a wish — checking this ledger is a control.
$comment: HOST: trace.schema.json -> add a `coverage_attested` block per criterion assessment.

sample_seed.description: Sampling is forced by the runtime, never chosen by the agent — letting the agent pick its own validation sample is the runtime version of the circularity the evidence-universe service exists to prevent. The seed is recorded so an audit can confirm which documents were drawn, and so a run replays deterministically.

through_date.description: The date this negative conclusion actually reaches — normally observable_period.end. A negative claim without it is unscopeable and has no truth value. Must be surfaced to the consumer, not buried in the trace.

through_date_lag_days.description: snapshot_date minus through_date. A large lag means the conclusion is old news; flag it rather than let it pass as equivalent to a current one.

windows_clipped.description: Windows dropped as out_of_scope (before anchor / after observable end). These enter neither the gate nor the elusion computation.

finality.description: P9 once more. 'Provisional' has two causes whose remedies differ, so it must carry a reason; collapsing them means scheduling reruns that can never resolve.

reason.description: PENDING_FILING: the event happened and the document exists but has not landed — waiting fixes it, so schedule a rerun. OBSERVATION_TRUNCATED: the patient stopped being observed — waiting fixes nothing unless they return; accept the truncated scope or go to an external source. Both can hold at once, hence an array.

recall_lower_bound.description: Reported, NOT gated. Unstable when k is small: with k=2, U=400, m=50 the bound is ~0.08, and reaching 0.95 would need m of roughly 11,000 — larger than the whole pool. The gate therefore rests on whether the exclusion declaration and the keyword list survived sampling, not on recall.

elusion_upper.description: Clopper-Pearson one-sided upper bound on the relevance rate of the unreviewed remainder. Exhaustively reviewed strata are genuinely 0. A searched stratum is NOT 0 unless its misses were sampled.

disposition.description: Only interior_gap blocks the gate. The two out_of_scope values are clipped away and are not evidence gaps — treating a lost-to-follow-up patient as a gap would fail nearly every real surveillance record.
